about: A completion gate that refuses every task: every check that must let a task complete fails.

mutations.find: export const unmet = (lw) => COMPLETION.filter((row) => !row.holds(lw)).map((row) => ({ id: row.id, say: row.say }));
mutations.replace: export const unmet = () => COMPLETION.map((row) => ({ id: row.id, say: row.say }));
